mapper.select: SELECT fnd31_opr_fund_id AS opr_fund_id , fnd31_opr_id AS opr_id , fnd31_fund_id AS fund_id , fnd31_fund_advice_type AS fund_advice_type , c.fund_cd AS fund_code , c.fund_nm AS fund_name , fnd31_price AS price , fnd31_qty AS qty , fnd31_cont_amt AS cont_amt , fnd31_fee AS fee , fnd31_settle_amt AS settle_amt FROM fnd31_opr_fund INNER JOIN ( SELECT fnd01_fund_code_id fund_id , fnd01_fund_cd fund_cd , fnd02_fund_nm fund_nm FROM fnd01_fund_code fnd01 , fnd02_fund_info fnd02 WHERE fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd02_fund_code_id AND (fnd02_fund_code_id, fnd02_work_date) IN ( SELECT a.fnd02_fund_code_id, MAX(a.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info a WHERE a.fnd02_work_date <= f_sysdate() GROUP BY a.fnd02_fund_code_id )) c ON fnd31_fund_id = c.fund_id WHERE fnd31_opr_id = #{oprId} UNION SELECT fnd31_opr_fund_id , fnd31_opr_id , fnd31_fund_id , fnd31_fund_advice_type , adv02_manage_cd , adv02_manage_nm , fnd31_price , fnd31_qty , fnd31_cont_amt , fnd31_fee , fnd31_settle_amt FROM fnd31_opr_fund INNER JOIN adv02_account ON adv02_account_id = fnd31_fund_id WHERE fnd31_opr_id = #{oprId} ORDER BY fund_id

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT fnd31_opr_fund_id AS opr_fund_id , fnd31_opr_id AS opr_id , fnd31_fund_id AS fund_id , fnd31_fund_advice_type AS fund_advice_type , CASE WHEN fnd31_fund_advice_type = '2' THEN (SELECT adv02_manage_cd FROM adv02_account WHERE adv02_account_id = fnd31_fund_id) ELSE (SELECT fnd01_fund_cd FROM fnd01_fund_code WHERE fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd31_fund_id) END AS fund_code , CASE WHEN fnd31_fund_advice_type = '2' THEN (SELECT adv02_manage_nm FROM adv02_account WHERE adv02_account_id = fnd31_fund_id) ELSE (SELECT fnd02_fund_nm FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd31_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date = (SELECT MAX(a.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info a WHERE a.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd31_fund_id AND a.fnd02_work_date <= f_sysdate())) END AS fund_name , fnd31_price AS price , fnd31_qty AS qty , fnd31_cont_amt AS cont_amt , fnd31_fee AS fee , fnd31_settle_amt AS settle_amt FROM fnd31_opr_fund WHERE fnd31_opr_fund_id = #{oprFundId} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd31_opr_fund ( fnd31_opr_fund_id, fnd31_opr_id, fnd31_fund_id, fnd31_fund_advice_type, fnd31_price, fnd31_qty, fnd31_cont_amt, fnd31_fee, fnd31_settle_amt ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{r.oprId}, #{r.fundId}, #{r.fundAdviceType}, #{r.price}, #{r.qty}, #{r.contAmt}, #{r.fee}, #{r.settleAmt} )

INSERT INTO fnd31_opr_fund ( fnd31_opr_fund_id, fnd31_opr_id, fnd31_fund_id, fnd31_price, fnd31_qty, fnd31_cont_amt, fnd31_fee, fnd31_settle_amt, fnd31_fund_advice_type ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{oprId}, #{fundId}, NULL, #{qty}, NULL, NULL, #{settleAmt}, #{fundAdviceType} )
